text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A brand new Bakushin—Supernova Super Bakushin!
I will never give up first place...!
Haaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Nghh!!
Bakushin O-chan...!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: (What brilliance...! This is Bakushin O's—ultimate weapon!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooooah!!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaaa--!!
I. Lost. Horribly--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both North Flight and Sakura Bakushin O...
lost victory to other Umamusume.
However, the two of them—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"However, Flight!
Your speed was fantastic!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And wasn't my Bakushin
simply magnificent as well!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Truly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right!
—That is why I won't lose again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"If we combine control, Bakushin,
and even more speed... it's infinite!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, without a doubt...
I will win with this! Unrivaled speed!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well then!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Bakushin O-chan.
You really are... so very stylish!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even though you lost...
you are speed itself.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"The next time we meet on the turf……
I'm sure you will shine even brighter."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: (I want to polish my raw materials even more... and clash against you.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"With my own brilliance.
I want to beat you—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"A heart-pounding, fiery gaze!!
From where...—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
!
Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Hehehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha!!
That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's polish our skills even further!
As class representative, I'm ready!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Bakushin O-chan is looking at me.
Almost as if calling out to me.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Let's go.
Without fail—together!
